from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document: its title and case cause (案由)."""
    judgment_title: str | None = Field(description="The title/name of this judgment document")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The case cause (案由) recorded in this document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of document: 行政上诉裁定, 民事判决书, 行政非诉执行复议裁定, etc.")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
